groups.title: the readfirst command and the GitHub Action

checks.why: commands end to end on a scratch git repository, the Action against a fake GitHub

risks.text: action.yml passes inputs as INPUT_* env vars by hand (composite actions do not); a new input needs a line there
the PR comment is found again by its first line (MARKER); changing it makes every open PR get a second comment

groups.title: the map format, import reading and the read list

checks.why: format, patterns, imports and read list cases

risks.text: map.json files in users' repositories must keep working: add fields as optional, never rename or remove one without a new format version
the read list JSON is read by other tools (--json, the Action): keep field names
package.json "files" decides what npm ships; a new folder under src is fine, a new top-level folder must be added there

rules.rule: the readfirst command reads only the checkout: no network calls and no model calls
rules.why: it runs in agents' sandboxes and on private code; only the Action talks to the GitHub API

rules.rule: no runtime dependencies: Node's standard library only
rules.why: npx readfirst must start fast and nothing third-party runs on users' code
